title: Jim Cramer Can’t Help But Gloat At Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s AI Developments
excerpt: Ever the Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) bull, Jim Cramer is nothing but ecstatic about the firm’s recent fortunes. With a market capitalization of $4.90 trillion w...
content_html:
Ramish Cheema

Fri, July 31, 2026 at 7:58 PM PDT 3 min read

Ever the Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) bull, Jim Cramer is nothing but ecstatic about the firm's recent fortunes. With a market capitalization of $4.90 trillion when Cramer made his remarks, the firm was the most valuable company in the world once again after losing the place to NVIDIA. Most of the debate surrounding Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) has focused on its AI initiatives. While most big ticket tech firms such as Alphabet and Meta have gone 'all in' when it comes to the new technology, the consumer electronics firm has taken a more cautious approach. Yet, its massive user base has also allowed Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) to play a key role in the sector. Cramer has commented on these aspects regularly. He has gone as far as to joke that the firm is a 'freeloader' when it comes to AI and defended it from critics of the AI strategy. With Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) now once again the world's most valuable company, the CNBC TV host relished in the development in his Monday morning remarks:

"Apple the winner, repeatedly. Apple the winner, Apple the winner, Apple the winner. And they're the ones that all the really so called smart people told us, they didn't have AI right. Well I guess it was good not to have AI."

The bulls and bears, when it comes to Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL), are also split across AI monetization. While the bulls believe that the firm's massive user base and strong product launches provide it with plenty of room to support earnings expansion and keep its margins strong through pricing measures, the bears are uncertain whether Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL)'s user base can allow it to sufficiently monetize AI initiatives. Cramer is solidly in the bullish camp, as his remarks suggest that he views the firm as an 'AI safe haven.' Yet, this same status has led the bears to question valuation multiples as they wonder whether a high forward P/E of 35x can leave any room for error when it comes to delivering on the earnings front.

Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL)'s latest earnings report saw the shares dip 6% in aftermarket trading. During the earnings call, another key topic in the debate, i.e., the impact of high component costs, came into focus. Management cited supply constraints to hold back on their optimism for guidance. Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) guided its revenue growth for the current quarter to sit between 9% and 11%, while analysts had estimated 12%. Yet, Cramer remained a bull as he tweeted:

"Apple's issues are all memory and currency..."

However, he also agreed with the bearish caution about the multiple being too high for any financial weakness and tweeted:

拉米什·奇玛

太平洋夏令时间 2026 年 7 月 31 日星期五晚上 7:58 阅读时间 3 分钟

吉姆·克莱默（Jim Cramer）一直看好苹果公司（纳斯达克股票代码：AAPL），对该公司最近的业绩欣喜若狂。 Cramer 发表此番言论时，该公司的市值已达 4.90 万亿美元，在被 NVIDIA 取代后，该公司再次成为全球最有价值公司。 围绕苹果公司（纳斯达克股票代码：AAPL）的大部分争论都集中在其人工智能计划上。 虽然 Alphabet 和 Meta 等大多数大型科技公司在新技术方面都“全力以赴”，但这家消费电子公司却采取了更为谨慎的态度。 然而，其庞大的用户群也让苹果公司（纳斯达克股票代码：AAPL）在该领域发挥了关键作用。 克莱默定期对这些方面发表评论。 他甚至开玩笑说，在人工智能方面，该公司是一个“吃白吃的人”，并为人工智能战略的批评者辩护。 随着苹果公司（纳斯达克股票代码：AAPL）再次成为全球最有价值的公司，这位 CNBC 电视主持人在周一上午的讲话中对这一发展表示赞赏：

“苹果多次成为赢家。 苹果是赢家，苹果是赢家，苹果是赢家。 所有真正所谓的聪明人都告诉我们，他们没有人工智能的权利。 嗯，我想没有人工智能也很好。”

对于苹果公司（纳斯达克股票代码：AAPL）来说，在人工智能货币化方面，牛市和熊市也存在分歧。 虽然看多者认为，该公司庞大的用户基础和强劲的产品发布为其提供了足够的空间来支持盈利扩张，并通过定价措施保持强劲的利润率，但看空者不确定苹果公司（纳斯达克股票代码：AAPL）的用户基础能否使其充分利用人工智能计划货币化。 克莱默坚定地站在看涨阵营，因为他的言论表明他将该公司视为“人工智能安全港”。 然而，同样的状况也导致看空者质疑估值倍数，因为他们想知道 35 倍的高远期市盈率是否会在盈利方面留下任何犯错的空间。

苹果公司（纳斯达克股票代码：AAPL）最新财报显示，该公司股价在盘后交易中下跌 6%。 在财报电话会议上，争论中的另一个关键话题，即高零部件成本的影响，成为焦点。 管理层指出供应限制阻碍了他们对指导的乐观态度。 苹果公司（纳斯达克股票代码：AAPL）预计本季度收入增长在 9% 至 11% 之间，而分析师此前预计为 12%。 然而，克莱默仍然保持乐观态度，他在推特上写道：

“苹果的问题都是内存和货币……”

不过，他也同意对市盈率对于任何财务疲软而言都过高的悲观谨慎，并在推特上写道：
